command:
set -euo pipefail
PID=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/')
echo LIVE_PID=$PID
echo PROC_ARGS
tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$PID/cmdline; echo
echo XDOTOOL_BY_PID
IDS=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --pid $PID 2>/dev/null || true)
for id in $IDS; do echo WINDOW_ID=$id; DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell $id || true; DISPLAY=:0 xprop -id $id _NET_WM_PID WM_CLASS WM_NAME 2>/dev/null || true; DISPLAY=:0 xwininfo -id $id 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Absolute upper-left|Width:|Height:|Border width:|Depth:' || true; done
echo ALL_APP_WINDOWS
DISPLAY=:0 wmctrl -lpG 2>/dev/null | grep -E "[[:space:]]$PID[[:space:]]" || true
echo DISPLAY
DISPLAY=:0 xrandr --current | grep -E ' connected|current ' || true
echo LIVE_HASHES
sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service
